full_description: default: pick up the raw meat from the cutting board, place it on the pan to cook on contact, then put it back on the cutting board; option 1: hold the red cook key to cook; option 2: mirrored dual stations — both arms cook both steaks to target doneness then return them; option 1+2: dual stations each with a cook key (both steaks must be cooked properly)
schema: {A} notifies the meat, {B} notifies the pan, {C} notifies the cutting board, {E} notifies the cook key when option 1 is active, {n} notifies dual-station count when option 2 is on, {a} notifies the arm(s) that handle the meat, {o} notifies option 1 (cook button) and/or option 2 (dual setup)
preference: num of words should not exceed 20. Degree of detail avg is 6
